source_of_truth: xcodebuild test result bundle + xcrun xccov

policy.changed_code_expectation: No new or modified Domain/Application/Infrastructure code should reduce line coverage for touched files unless explicitly justified in PR notes.

layer_expectations.Domain: Prefer strong meaningful coverage. New logic should include direct tests.
layer_expectations.Application: Prefer strong meaningful coverage for use-case and orchestration paths.
layer_expectations.Infrastructure/Persistence: Prefer strong coverage around repository behavior and serialization pathways.
layer_expectations.Presentation/SwiftUI: Coverage is tracked, but strict percentage gating is secondary to behavior-oriented tests and smoke checks.

staged_adoption: Stage 1: freeze measured baseline from real xccov artifacts.
Stage 2 (current): enforce overall non-regression (0.5pp budget) and conservative non-test target non-regression (1.0pp budget).
Stage 3: add robust per-layer policy after stable multi-run evidence and better layer-to-coverage mapping.
